title: SAT is NP-hard
statement: Every language in NP has a polynomial-time many-one reduction to the language of binary strings whose total CNF decoding is satisfiable.
replaced: The language $\mathrm{SAT}$ of serialized Boolean CNF formulas admitting a satisfying assignment is $\mathrm{NP}$-hard: every language in $\mathrm{NP}$ polynomial-time many-one reduces to $\mathrm{SAT}$.
